full_name: Open Jurisdiction Packs for Microsoft Copilot Legal for Cowork
short_description: Jurisdiction packs for the legal skills
full_description: Adds jurisdiction detection, official sources, citation style, local personal identifiers, execution and governance checklists, business-day and holiday rules, and court AI rules to the built-in legal skills in Microsoft Copilot Cowork. Ships with packs for the Commonwealth of Australia, every Australian state and territory, New Zealand and Singapore; anyone can contribute a new jurisdiction. Pack entries are checklists to verify against primary sources, not legal advice.
